message: Hm?
She's here.
I can see her...

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...What? Stop staring like that."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You're by yourself. Did something happen again?"
(Tell her what happened.)

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I see. So she has passed on."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "How fortunate, to have met such a peaceful end."
"Is there anything I can do for you?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You would do that? For me?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You seem to think there's something special about being able to see me when you can't see the other ghosts anymore, but I'm..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "No... If this is fate's decree... then perhaps you are the one I've been waiting for."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "In that case, there is something you can do for me. I have a request."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Step back. Put some distance between us."
(Step back)

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Yes, that should be enough."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'll show you..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...What this place truly is... and what I truly am."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Behold, the Ghost Apartment."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "A den of wraiths, corrupted souls that devour the living."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Not a single record shows that a building ever stood here."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "And yet it is undeniably here, waiting for its next sacrifice."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Its accursed residents prey on anyone unfortunate enough to enter."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "They'll feast on their flesh, leaving them as nothing but a soul bound to this place—"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "—the very concierge who will draw in the next sacrifice."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Indeed, I am the current concierge, a captive soul that exists only to sate the residents' hunger."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If I sacrifice you, then I will become a resident as well. And you will take my place as the next concierge."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "But I don't want that."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The residents have long since lost themselves. Now they are nothing but mindless beasts ruled by hunger."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I reject that fate."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "And that is why I remain here."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I stepped into this mansion of my own will, and I stay here by my own choosing."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I have become part of this urban legend with my sense of self still intact."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Don't worry. I have no intention of offering you, or anyone else, as a sacrifice."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I will never yield the role of concierge. Not to you, not to anyone."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "When the residents grow restless, I sometimes feed them stray cats. But I will never give them a human."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "This apartment belongs to me now. I am in control."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I have become part of the urban legend... and in time, I myself will become one."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...The time has come for me to reveal my true name."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Spread the word, far and wide, to as many people as you can."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Of the Ghost Apartment, and its overseer..."

name: Shigure, Ageha
message: "Shigure, Ageha."

name: Shigure, Ageha
message: "I'm counting on you."

name: Shigure, Ageha
message: "So that the day will come when I, too, will become an urban legend..."

name: Shigure, Ageha
message: "Hehe... hehehehehehehe..."
She's gone.
Kashima Reiko-san... no. Shigure Ageha-san has vanished too.
It looks like I've taken on quite the job.
...I'll do what I can.
Time to go.
